tip: Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily
description: Helps maintain fluid balance, supports digestion, and keeps skin healthy.

tip: Start your day with a glass of warm water
description: Aids digestion and helps flush out toxins from the body.

tip: Walk for at least 30 minutes every day
description: Improves heart health and keeps the body active without needing a gym.

tip: Stretch for 5–10 minutes after waking up
description: Helps loosen muscles and increases flexibility for the day ahead.

tip: Include green leafy vegetables in your daily meals
description: Rich in iron, vitamins, and fiber, good for immunity and digestion.

tip: Eat fresh seasonal fruits regularly
description: Provides natural vitamins and antioxidants needed by the body.

tip: Avoid eating too much oily or deep-fried food
description: Helps reduce cholesterol and risk of heart problems.

tip: Use mustard oil or sunflower oil for cooking in moderation

tip: Get 7 to 8 hours of quality sleep every night
description: Essential for brain function, mood, and body recovery.

tip: Eat home-cooked meals more often than outside food

tip: Limit sugar intake in tea, snacks, and desserts
description: Helps prevent weight gain, diabetes, and energy crashes.

tip: Wash your hands before eating and after using the toilet
description: Prevents the spread of infections and stomach-related diseases.

tip: Use turmeric and ginger regularly in food

tip: Don’t skip breakfast
description: Boosts metabolism and helps maintain energy throughout the day.

tip: Practice deep breathing or meditation for 10 minutes daily
description: Reduces stress, calms the mind, and improves focus.

tip: Avoid smoking and reduce alcohol consumption

tip: Spend some time in natural sunlight daily
description: Supports vitamin D production and improves mood.

tip: Eat dal (lentils) regularly
description: A good source of protein, especially in vegetarian diets.

tip: Limit intake of salty snacks and pickles

tip: Include curd or yogurt in your diet

tip: Avoid skipping meals during busy days

tip: Eat slowly and chew your food well

tip: Use stairs instead of lifts whenever possible

tip: Keep a fixed sleep and wake-up schedule

tip: Wear comfortable footwear while walking

tip: Boil drinking water if unsure of its safety

tip: Take short breaks during long hours of sitting

tip: Keep nails trimmed and clean

tip: Practice good posture while standing and sitting

tip: Use clean and fresh oil while cooking

tip: Check blood pressure once every few months

tip: Eat a light dinner at least 2 hours before sleeping

tip: Use natural spices like cumin, fenugreek, and black pepper

tip: Maintain personal hygiene during summer and monsoon

tip: Practice safe food storage in hot weather

tip: Avoid excessive screen time, especially before sleep

tip: Keep a small bottle of water with you when going out

tip: Speak kindly to yourself and others

tip: Laugh regularly and spend time with loved ones

tip: Keep your surroundings clean and organized

tip: Dry your clothes properly in sunlight

tip: Eat nuts like peanuts or almonds in small amounts

tip: Don’t overuse painkillers or self-medicate

tip: Listen to calming music when stressed

tip: Eat whole grains like brown rice and millet

tip: Carry an umbrella or hat when out in the sun
